stem: A pharmacy will place an acute-use ADD inside a Massachusetts inpatient hospice. Which requirements are part of the current hospice pathway? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Continuously monitor the ADD by video
Keep medications in the hospice ADD as pharmacy property until they are dispensed.
Skip prescription reconciliation because the medications are palliative
Obtain a machine-specific Massachusetts Controlled Substance Registration
Determine whether a machine-specific DEA registration is required

explanation.core_reasoning: Hospice acute-use ADDs require machine-specific state registration, DEA assessment, continuous video, pharmacy ownership, and prescription reconciliation.

choice_analysis.B: The hospice ADD pathway preserves pharmacy ownership until dispensing.
choice_analysis.C: ADD dispensing must be reconciled with prescriptions.
choice_analysis.D: The hospice circular requires a machine-specific CSR.
choice_analysis.E: The pharmacy must make that DEA determination.

related_facts: General Massachusetts ADD requirements also apply.
explanation.mpje_trap: Assuming hospice status relaxes machine-level controls.

reasoning_steps: Apply registration, monitoring, ownership, and reconciliation rules
